name: Wildcraft: Trees and Shrubs
//: New trees' logs, leaves, saplings, seeds, stumps and saps. The base game's values for the same families (logs 32, leaves 1, saplings 32) are copied, since these are the same things from more species; most already borrow them through variant guessing and this fills what's left. Only used when nothing else values the item; the '//' lines say why each number was chosen.

defaultValues.//lognarrow-*: a thin log: half a log
defaultValues.//stump-*: a stump is a log's worth of wood
defaultValues.//wildcrafttree:leaves-*: edible leaves: two leaf blocks' worth
defaultValues.//mulch: ground-up leaves, between leaves (1) and soil (4)
defaultValues.//chlorociboria: a fungus: like the game's mushrooms (16)
defaultValues.//poultice-*: a cloth (about 8) plus the sap (16); normally made by its recipe
defaultValues.//table-petrified: a petrified wood table: like an altar block (64)
defaultValues.//wattlebasket-*: a woven basket: four sticks' worth (4 each)
